The '''heavy sonic pistol''' or '''heavy sonic blaster''' was a [[Sonic weapon/Legends|sonic weapon]] that fired compressed bolts of sonic energy. It was a more powerful version of the [[sonic pistol]].

==Description==
The heavy sonic pistol was a debilitating weapon of unknown origin. Unlike many lesser [[sonic pistol]] models, this weapon, with the proper technical tweaks, was capable of causing a higher degree of sonic damage than a [[sonic rifle]]. Additionally, many types of [[Personal energy shield/Legends|shields]] and defenses were unable to block sonic attacks.<ref name="KOTOR 2 Prima Official Guide" />

As with all sonic weapons, the heavy sonic pistol was particularly effective against [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] because the weapon's sonic bolt bent around the [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]], making deflection impossible.<ref name="Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide" /> Additionally, the sonic energy was sometimes able to disrupt a target's equilibrium, causing disorientation.<ref name="KOTOR 2 Prima Official Guide" />
